summary: We aim to meet the needs of the Interplanetary Survival Guide challenge by developing a route planning software alongside a Raspberry Pi based navigator hardware that helps guide users across Mars without the need for GPS, making human based traversal across Mars significantly more feasible.
details: The project tackles the challenge of planning and navigating a route customizable routes on Mars Missions, particularly in the Jezora Crater region. By creating a map with adjustable markers and a route calculator which finds the best and safest path, and feeding this data into a raspberry pi with an accelerometer and a gyroscope, the device guides astronauts with a simple HUD, arrow and progress bar, helping astronauts stay on track during their expedition.
